answers: lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — The design fully addresses this scenario. Gap 11 in the Context/gaps section explicitly names the problem: after `skip_until_stage` is cleared when the from-stage target is found, `resume_mode` remains `true`, causing the resume skip guard to activate for subsequent units marked complete. The Decision paragraph requires the fix: in both dispatch-unit arms (cycle:* and stage:*) of `main()` in runner.sh, immediately after clearing `skip_until_stage`, also set `resume_mode=false` — preventing the resume skip guard from firing for any stage after `<s>` in combined `--resume --from-stage <s>` mode. Pure resume runs never set `skip_until_stage` so this change is unreachable in that path. DSFSTG-3[code] provides the observable test: a 3-unit fixture `[intake, cyc, verify]` with all three stages marked complete, invoked with `--resume --from-stage cyc`, must still dispatch `verify` (stage.start emitted) even though it was marked complete. The test fails on old code (verify skipped because `resume_mode` stays `true`) and passes after the fix. Findings 30 and 31 in the Findings section both confirm this is covered.
